name: Marjoram

schedule.notes: Surface-sow; tiny seeds need light. Slow to germinate.
More tender than oregano — wait for warm soil.
Cut just before flowering for peak flavor; trim by half for a second flush.

harvest.cues: Stems 6 in, leaves small, gray-green, soft. Bunches of buds on stem tips just opening.
harvest.storageNotes: Dries beautifully — hang bundles in shade. Slightly sweeter than oregano dried.

varieties.name: Sweet Marjoram
varieties.notes: The cooking marjoram. Sweet, balsamic, more delicate than oregano.

notes: Grow as an annual below zone 7. Often called 'sweet oregano' — milder, sweeter, better in delicate dishes. Excellent with poultry and eggs.
